purpose: Gives screening results, surveillance intervals and referral for an abdominal aortic aneurysm measured on ultrasound within the NHS AAA Screening Programme.
exam: NHS AAA Screening Programme abdominal aortic ultrasound
issuer: NHS England (NHS Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Screening Programme)
system: NHS abdominal aortic aneurysm screening programme: screening results, surveillance intervals and referral thresholds

inputs.label: Scan done within the NHS AAA screening programme
inputs.how_stated: true when this ultrasound is an NHS AAA screening programme scan (the initial screen or a programme surveillance scan); false for any other aortic imaging, such as a diagnostic or incidental finding outside the programme

locator.section: AAA screening

inputs.label: Sex
inputs.how_stated: patient sex, usually from the request details

locator.section: AAA screening: screening is not routinely offered to women

inputs.label: AAA already treated
inputs.how_stated: true when the patient has already had an abdominal aortic aneurysm treated (open repair or endovascular stent-graft, EVAR), from the history or a graft seen on the scan; false for a native, untreated aorta

locator.section: AAA screening: screening is not routinely offered to anyone who has already been treated for an AAA

inputs.label: Abdominal aortic diameter
inputs.how_stated: the aortic diameter recorded on this screening ultrasound, in cm (the programme reports in cm, e.g. 'aorta 3.6 cm'; a value given in mm, e.g. '36 mm', is the same measurement); the pathway requirements do not state the measurement plane, so use the programme's own recorded diameter. not_assessable when the aorta could not be visualised on this scan

locator.section: AAA screening: 4 possible AAA screening results based on the size of the abdominal aorta

inputs.label: Previous programme scan measuring the aneurysm
inputs.how_stated: true when this is a surveillance scan and an earlier programme scan measured the aneurysm (a man already under AAA surveillance); false for the initial screen

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Surveillance

inputs.label: Growth in aortic diameter over 12 months
inputs.how_stated: increase in the aortic diameter over the last 12 months, in cm: this scan's diameter minus the diameter about 12 months earlier, e.g. 'grown from 4.1 to 5.3 cm in a year' is 1.2 cm; 0 or negative when unchanged or smaller

locator.section: AAA screening: those whose aneurysm has grown by more than 1cm in 12 months are offered a referral to vascular services
AAA screening: no AAA found (less than 3.0cm); small AAA (3.0cm to 4.4cm); medium AAA (4.5cm to 5.4cm); large AAA (5.5cm and larger)
3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral (grown by more than 1cm in 12 months)
AAA screening: scan offered to men in the year they turn 65; not routinely offered to women or anyone already treated for an AAA
2. Screening test: Carrying out the screening test (aorta could not be visualised; inconclusive scans)
2. Screening test: Carrying out the screening test (no aneurysm detected)
4. After screening test (intervention): points at which active inclusion ends are in the AAA screening standard operating procedure
2. Screening test: Surveillance (yearly surveillance scans for small aneurysms)
2. Screening test: Surveillance (scans every 3 months for medium aneurysms)
3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral (aneurysm grown by more than 1cm in 12 months)
3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral (large aneurysm)

outcomes.classification: NHS AAA screening programme thresholds apply only to programme scans; the programme does not routinely screen women, men under 65 or anyone already treated for an AAA.

locator.section: AAA screening: scan offered to men in the year they turn 65; not routinely offered to women or anyone already treated for an AAA

outcomes.classification: Aorta not visualised: inconclusive AAA screen.
outcomes.recommendation: A further programme scan will be offered.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Carrying out the screening test (aorta could not be visualised; inconclusive scans)

caveats: The programme sends a further screening invitation after a non-visualised initial screen; it does not say what follows a non-visualised surveillance scan.

outcomes.classification: No AAA found: aortic diameter less than 3.0 cm.
outcomes.recommendation: No further AAA screening scans or invitations needed.

locator.section: AAA screening: no AAA found (less than 3.0cm); 2. Screening test: no aneurysm detected

outcomes.recommendation: Yearly AAA surveillance scans; the programme also offers a vascular nurse specialist appointment for health and lifestyle advice.
caveats: Growth of more than 1 cm in 12 months on surveillance prompts referral to vascular services instead.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Surveillance (yearly surveillance scans for small aneurysms; vascular nurse specialist appointment)

outcomes.recommendation: AAA surveillance scans every 3 months; the programme also offers a vascular nurse specialist appointment for health and lifestyle advice.
caveats: Growth of more than 1 cm in 12 months on surveillance prompts referral to vascular services instead.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Surveillance (scans every 3 months for medium aneurysms; vascular nurse specialist appointment)

outcomes.classification: AAA {diameter_band} that has grown by more than 1 cm in 12 months.
outcomes.recommendation: Offer referral to vascular services within one working day; a vascular specialist appointment should follow within 2 weeks of the scan.

locator.section: 3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral

outcomes.recommendation: Offer referral to vascular services within one working day; a vascular specialist appointment should follow within 2 weeks of the scan.
caveats: Fit men who opt for surgery should be treated within 8 weeks of the scan.

locator.section: 3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral; 4. After screening test (intervention)

outcomes.classification: Aortic diameter less than 3.0 cm in a man already under AAA surveillance: not defined by the pathway requirements.
outcomes.recommendation: Manage per the AAA screening standard operating procedure.
caveats: Library addition: the pathway requirements do not say what happens when a surveillance scan measures under 3.0 cm; they point to the standard operating procedure for when active inclusion ends.

locator.section: 4. After screening test (intervention): points at which active inclusion ends are in the AAA screening standard operating procedure

summary.text: The NHS offers men an AAA screening ultrasound in the screening year they turn 65; men over 65 who have not been screened can self-refer.

locator.section: AAA screening

summary.text: Four screening results by aortic size: no AAA (under 3.0 cm), small (3.0 to 4.4 cm), medium (4.5 to 5.4 cm) and large (5.5 cm or larger).

locator.section: AAA screening

summary.text: In the programme, small aneurysms get yearly surveillance scans and medium aneurysms scans every 3 months; large aneurysms, and any that grow by more than 1 cm in 12 months, are offered referral to vascular services.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Surveillance; 3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral

definitions.text: Surveillance: repeat programme scans of men with aneurysms from 3 cm to 5.4 cm to check whether they are getting bigger.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: Surveillance

tables.title: NHS AAA screening programme: results and next step
rows: Referral to vascular services within one working day

locator.section: AAA screening; 2. Screening test: Surveillance; 3. After screening test (diagnosis): Referral

pitfalls.text: These thresholds and intervals belong to the NHS AAA screening programme (men screened from 65); they do not apply to women, men under 65, treated aneurysms, or AAAs found outside the programme.

locator.section: AAA screening

pitfalls.text: The pathway requirements do not state how the diameter is measured; the scan follows the programme's clinical guidance, which this entry does not cover. If two diameters are dictated, this entry uses the larger.

locator.section: 2. Screening test: perform the ultrasound scan in accordance with the AAA screening clinical guidance

pitfalls.text: When a man leaves active surveillance is set by the AAA screening standard operating procedure, not by this entry.

locator.section: 4. After screening test (intervention)
